scope: Experimental training only; accuracy/promotion require separate held-out and native evaluation

readiness.scope: Read-only structural readiness; no fitting, promotion, label correctness or temporal continuity claim.
readiness.minimum_note: YOLO trainer minimum: 30 reviewed frames and five positive/five verified absent per independent split; this is not sufficient sample size or acceptance.
readiness.continuity_note: Consecutive IDs/timestamps and burst IDs supply structural windows only. Cuts, repeated footage and exposure interruptions require a separate continuity audit.
readiness.environment_note: This audit does not assess the training environment. Separate forward/loss/backward/finite-gradient/optimizer evidence is required.
